Gosto de entender essas coisas antes de: I like to understand those things before thinking about colours, typefaces or references. Not because there's some foolproof formula, but because creating without understanding the problem usually takes the long way round.
Pode parecer óbvio, mas nem sempre essas: It might sound obvious, but those questions don't always get the attention they deserve.
